summary: Re-audit of the SA's in-place revision. All 9 prior findings are genuinely resolved, each verified against actual source this session (not accepted on claim). The two blocking HIGH findings are fully closed: (DES-AUD-001) the false 'already fire' linchpin assertion is gone; the design now states plainly that backupStateChanged/restoreStateChanged are DIRECT-call methods (verified SmsBackupService:259 called from BackupTask:273; SmsRestoreService:178 from RestoreTask:328), that no syncStateRepository collector exists in either service, and that the workers emit only setProgress — therefore a service-side WorkInfo observer (Option b1) is now a REQUIRED, ordered Step-2a prerequisite of the dispatch migration, fully consistent with the R-2 risk box (no remaining contradiction). (DES-AUD-002) the grep-to-zero scope now includes comment/javadoc; re-greped this session => exactly 20 matches (2 code + 18 comment) matching the design's enumeration line-for-line; the design mandates rewording the 12 surviving residuals and the Design Validation grep criterion explicitly says 'zero output lines, comments and javadoc {@code} included.' The 4 MEDIUM and 3 LOW are all addressed and source-verified (auth trace at K9MailTransport:155-247/372; cancel call-site at StatusPreference:281-283/306-308 with BackupCancelCollector sole consumer; factory-deletion divergence explicitly flagged as REQ-013-owns / REQ-014-verifies; clearCache retained in SmsRestoreService.onCreate verified :63/:161; frontmatter title/type/integration_contracts populated; MessageConverterTest callers enumerated :121-169 with correct no-thrown-assertion finding). Previously-verified-correct content (012->013->014 sequencing, CalendarSyncer MissingBinding chain, CNTR-MODERNIZATION-004 scheduleManual gate) is intact and re-confirmed. One NEW non-blocking MEDIUM inconsistency introduced by the revision: a single stale '9 surviving' count at line 852 contradicts the correct '12' used everywhere load-bearing (Context disposition table, Component Design scrub decision, Design Validation row) and the grep ground-truth (12). Does not reintroduce the DES-AUD-002 root cause and does not block; flagged for a one-token cleanup. No HIGH issue remains or was newly introduced.
